items.title: At least 8,005 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since October 7. More than 1,400 people were killed in Israel.
At least 100 people are killed and over 300 others are injured by an al-Shabaab double car bombing in Mogadishu.
At least 151 people are killed and 82 others injured in a crowd crush during Halloween celebrations in Itaewon, Seoul, South Korea.
South Korea: Seoul Halloween crowd crush: at least 156 people are killed and 172 people are injured after a large crowd of people are crushed in a narrow street.
Russia reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 1,163 deaths from COVID-19, bringing the nationwide death toll to 236,220.
A mudslide in south-central Sri Lanka kills more than 100 people.
Federal Reserve rate decision: cut by 0.50 point, to a target of 1.00% (effective 2008-10-29)
At least 100 people die after a 6.4 magnitude earthquake in Pakistan in the city of Ziarat.
In the Valigonda train wreck a train derails in Andhra Pradesh, India, killing at least 116.
